summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin 38.1.4 executes obfuscated bundled payload via installer-dropped Bun runtime at preinstall
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is an obfuscated loader that, when no local `bun` binary is found, downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), extracts the bun executable to a temporary directory, chmod +x's it, and then execFileSync's a sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly-dropped runtime. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation and hex-named identifiers; it is not referenced from dist/index.js and is not part of the plugin's ESLint rule surface. An ESLint rules plugin has no functional need for a second JavaScript runtime, and the alternate-runtime dispatch pattern is used specifically to run opaque code outside Node-based install-time inspection. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook on every installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
